name: io.github.cola-sk/figma-context-mcp
description: MCP server that converts Figma designs to token-aware code generation context for AI agents

environmentVariables.description: Your personal access token for the Figma API
environmentVariables.name: FIGMA_ACCESS_TOKEN

environmentVariables.description: Absolute path to the ti-d-design-token repository. Used to infer token files from manifest.json.
environmentVariables.name: TI_DESIGN_TOKEN_DIR

environmentVariables.description: Token set id to consume from the design token repository, such as d or b. Defaults to d.
environmentVariables.name: TI_TOKEN_SET

environmentVariables.description: Default style strategy when the tool call does not pass styleStrategy. Use tokensOnly to report token gaps instead of falling back to literals.
environmentVariables.name: FIGMA_STYLE_STRATEGY

environmentVariables.description: Token metadata verbosity. compact keeps code-generation essentials; full includes references, resolved values, and chains for debugging. Defaults to compact.
environmentVariables.name: FIGMA_TOKEN_DETAIL

environmentVariables.description: Set to true while debugging to include compact raw Figma boundVariables in the returned node JSON.
environmentVariables.name: FIGMA_INCLUDE_VARIABLES

environmentVariables.description: Set to true to request and include raw vector path data. This can make responses much larger.
environmentVariables.name: FIGMA_INCLUDE_VECTOR_PATHS

environmentVariables.description: Advanced override: absolute path to ti-d-variables-token.json
environmentVariables.name: FIGMA_VARIABLES_TOKEN_FILE

environmentVariables.description: Advanced override: absolute path to generated CSS variable metadata, e.g. ti-d-css-variables.json
environmentVariables.name: FIGMA_CSS_VARIABLES_FILE

environmentVariables.description: Advanced override: absolute path to remote-variable-aliases.json
environmentVariables.name: FIGMA_VARIABLE_ALIAS_FILE
